title: Toronto's Greatest Hits Walking Tour
blurb:
Our tour guides are welcoming and friendly and we are so excited to share our city with you. 

We will take you through the streets and will stop at the most iconic and photo-worthy spots while fostering new friendships! 

The tour will focus heavily on the history of the buildings we visit, including accounts about some of the architects and influential people who somehow shaped what you see in the present day. 

We will take you to the PATH, the world’s largest underground shopping complex, with 32 kilometers (20 miles), connecting over 70 office buildings, subway stations, hotels, and a railway terminal.
